narratives.Overview: libxumux is a cross-platform TypeScript library targeting both Node.js and web browsers (user-provided runtime).
narratives.TechStack: Library using TypeScript — isomorphic, no Node.js-specific APIs; must run in both Node.js and web browser environments.
narratives.Quality: Run task check before every commit. Achieve >= 85% coverage overall + per-module. Store secrets in secrets/ dir.
narratives.ProjectRules: Library must work in both Node.js and web browsers.
